env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Investigate any target — email, username, domain, IP, name
env_context_strategy.note: No repository/environment context injection; task text is the target string.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: The AI issues hard-stop tool calls; your code executes the real binary
tool_call_format.note: Anthropic/OpenAI tool-use APIs; also exposed via MCP.

tool_count.evidence_quote: 19 modular tools | Email, username, breach, WHOIS, IP, subdomain, dorks, paste, phone, Shodan, VirusTotal, Censys, IP2Location, AbuseIPDB, GitHub, DNS, live dork search, URL scraping, SERP footprint
tool_count.note: Plus 3 optional graph MCP tools with the graph extra.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: 19 investigation tools behind a natural-language interface.
edit_primitive.note: Tool list contains no file-editing tool.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Expose all 19 OpenOSINT tools to any MCP-compatible AI client.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Native MCP server | All 19 tools exposed to Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and any MCP-compatible client

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The agent selects and chains tools based on findings; describe the target in plain language
loop_primitives.note: --parallel runs complementary tools concurrently; playbooks/recipes exist in openosint/playbooks/.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the agent decides which tools to run and chains them on findings

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: AI-powered OSINT agent with interactive REPL, MCP server, and CLI.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: AI-powered OSINT agent with interactive REPL, MCP server, and CLI.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: `<target>` | Investigate any target — email, username, domain, IP, name
human_in_loop.note: No per-action approval documented; human review queue exists only in the optional graph dedup module.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: All sessions are auto-saved to `~/.openosint/history/`. Browse with `openosint history`.
long_term_memory.note: Optional graph extra persists an append-only SQLite entity store (~/.openosint/graph.db).

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Session history | All REPL sessions saved to `~/.openosint/history/`; browse with `openosint history`
state_persistence.note: History is browsable but no documented resume-into-agent path.

self_verification.evidence_quote: your code executes the real binary — hallucinated findings are structurally impossible
self_verification.note: No harness-run tests, linters, or judge over agent output.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: If a binary is absent, the corresponding tool returns a descriptive error. All other tools remain operational.

rollback.evidence_quote:
An additive [FollowTheMoney](https://followthemoney.tech/) entity graph —
statement-level provenance, an append-only store
rollback.note: Read-only investigation tools; no repo/file state to revert.

cost_controls.note: Provider choice is a user flag, not content/cost-based routing; no token budget or caching documented.

execution_isolation.note: Docker compose shipped as an alternative.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Reports are persisted to `./reports/` via a volume mount.
filesystem_access.note: Runs as a local process with the user's own filesystem rights.

network_policy.evidence_quote:
a generic upstream-proxy
layer that any HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy provider — RapidProxy included — can be
pointed at.
network_policy.note: Tools call external APIs freely; only an optional proxy setting.

permission_model.evidence_quote: The AI issues hard-stop tool calls; your code executes the real binary

tracing.note: Sessions also saved to ~/.openosint/history/ and reports to reports/.

replayability.note: Sessions viewable, no replay mechanism documented.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Full per-tool documentation, CLI flags, and output formats: [openosint.tech](https://openosint.tech/).
eval_hooks.note: No benchmark evaluation runner in the file tree; tests/ are unit tests.

guardrails.evidence_quote: OpenOSINT is intended for **legal and authorized use only**.
guardrails.note: Policy is documentation-level; a privacy_proxy_denylist.json exists only in the optional graph module.

target_domain.evidence_quote: OSINT agent for security researchers and analysts: 19 investigation tools behind a natural-language interface.
target_domain.note: Domain is OSINT/threat intelligence; 'other' is the closest value.

open_source.evidence_quote: OpenOSINT is open source under the [MIT License](./LICENSE)

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Three AI backends | Anthropic Claude (default), local Ollama, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (LiteLLM, vLLM, LM Studio, ...)
